name: guideframe-grid
title: GuideframeGrid
description: Design-tool layout grids, rulers and draggable, snapping guides drawn over the live page or one container, with a keyboard-reachable control panel and a geometry inspector.
author: Dinil Thilakarathne <https://github.com/Dinil-Thilakarathne>
docs:
Installed `GuideframeGrid` and `useGuideframe` in `components/guideframe-grid/` (the vendored engine is in `core/`). They mount layout columns, rulers, draggable snapping guides, a control panel and a geometry inspector into a shadow root, so nothing renders into your React tree and your CSS cannot reach the overlay.

First, render it once near the root of your app. Like upstream, it mounts in development and stays out of production builds (`NODE_ENV === "production"`); pass `enabled` to override that either way:

```tsx
import { GuideframeGrid } from "@/components/guideframe-grid/GuideframeGrid";

<GuideframeGrid rulers />
```

- Press Cmd/Ctrl+G to toggle the grid and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+G for the control panel; drag from a ruler to place a guide.
- To scope it to one element, pass `container` from a state ref (`useState` plus `ref={setEl}`); the container must be positioned.
- Colors follow the `--guideframe-grid-*` variables added to your CSS (defaults match upstream); the `color` prop still overrides the columns.
